name: Executive AI Lab (India / DPDP)
description: Awarded for completing and passing the Executive AI Lab: board-level AI oversight, legal liability, ISO 42001 and governance frameworks, AI budget allocation, incident response, audit-ready assurance, and board accountability under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

criteria.narrative: Complete all 11 lessons and their interactive labs — including an incident tabletop, a budget allocation exercise and a written board paper assessed against a rubric — then pass a 20-question assessment at 70% or above. The assessment is taken online and is not proctored.
